fixtures.name: collection_reload_add_remove_disable_and_reenable_publish_query_settings
fixtures.scenario: Reload settings to add a relative-root collection, remove the old collection, disable documents and re-enable the attached store.
oracles: Durable lexical hits and collection names match the accepted settings after every edit.
Facade preview settings and enabled flag reflect accepted settings.
Source files remain intact; removed root watches retire.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_globs_and_roots_preserve_retained_embeddings
fixtures.scenario: Expand glob and root admission, then shrink roots with a fixed mock embedding model.
oracles: Retained source chunk IDs remain unchanged.
Only newly admitted text reaches the mock embedding model.
Retired sources disappear from durable results.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_default_and_collection_chunking_replace_only_affected_chunks
fixtures.scenario: Change default chunk size, then a collection override.
oracles: Affected collections have the expected chunk counts and replacement IDs.
A collection with unchanged effective settings retains its chunk ID.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_invalid_settings_and_identity_changes_keep_working_policy
fixtures.scenario: Propose malformed TOML, invalid glob/chunk settings, changed index/workspace roots and changed embedding settings.
oracles: Accepted facade document settings and code roots remain unchanged.
The original durable chunk ID remains searchable.
Rejected proposals leave no pending apply.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_failed_batch_preserves_all_collections_then_retries_without_event
fixtures.scenario: Remove one collection and add another while the fixed mock model fails, then advance the idle retry clock.
oracles: The old collection remains durable and the new collection is absent after failure.
Accepted settings and active watch registry remain unchanged on failure.
Idle retry publishes only the new collection without another source event.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_removal_prunes_pending_retry_and_rejects_captured_old_actions
fixtures.scenario: Remove a collection while an old retry and previously captured reconciliation action exist.
oracles: Pending retry state is empty after removal.
Old actions and later source events do not recreate collection data.
Source files remain on disk.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_transfers_source_ownership_atomically_and_preserves_pinned_queries
fixtures.scenario: Move source ownership to a collection sorted earlier by name, then propose overlapping ownership.
oracles: New durable results identify the new owning collection.
An already pinned query still identifies the old owner.
Overlapping ownership failure retains the accepted collection roots and results.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_committed_generation_wins_over_failed_state_mirror
fixtures.scenario: Obstruct state.json mirror publication with a directory while removing a collection.
oracles: Durable results and accepted live configuration both reflect the committed removal.
The committed change does not remain queued as a failed proposal.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_managed_roots_and_code_document_overlap_keep_separate_admission
fixtures.scenario: Seed an existing code file through its absolute source lane, admit it as a document, then remove document collections.
oracles: The same source is visible in both indexes while admitted.
Subsequent code updates still work after document removal.
Explicit managed roots admit no generated documents or managed-root watches.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_without_attached_store_requires_restart_without_loading_a_model
fixtures.scenario: Propose document settings in a watcher without an attached document store.
oracles: Current settings and durable indexed data remain unchanged.
The unsupported proposal is rejected without constructing a model.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_alias_missing_roots_and_dangling_links_respect_workspace_boundary
fixtures.scenario: Reload alias/missing roots and reject dangling links, a foreign ACL root and a canonical file-symlink escape.
oracles: Equivalent aliases retain source IDs; later missing-root creation is indexed.
Invalid and unauthorized roots preserve accepted settings.
Foreign source text never reaches durable results.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_retargeted_startup_alias_compares_accepted_canonical_roots
fixtures.scenario: Retarget a startup symlink before the first settings reload.
oracles: Comparison uses the previously accepted canonical root.
The old inventory is replaced immediately with the new target inventory.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_overflow_cancels_pending_proposals_after_invalid_or_deleted_settings
fixtures.scenario: Lose a malformed/deleted settings event while an earlier failed proposal awaits retry, then reconcile overflow.
oracles: Overflow cancels the old pending proposal.
Accepted settings and the original durable chunk ID remain unchanged.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_observed_settings_edits_cancel_retries_before_debounce
fixtures.scenario: Admit a newer malformed/deleted settings event, including a parent-directory event, while an old retry is due before the new debounce expires.
oracles: The old proposal is canceled at event admission.
Expiring the old retry clock cannot change settings or the durable original chunk.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_missing_or_directory_settings_never_apply_defaults
fixtures.scenario: Remove the explicitly watched settings file or replace it with a directory before the real configuration handler reads it, while an earlier disable proposal is queued.
oracles: The real handler returns a configuration read error instead of a default-settings proposal.
The newer settings event cancels the queued disable proposal.
After dispatch, accepted document settings, the durable original chunk ID and source file remain unchanged.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_recovers_a_committed_generation_before_a_reverted_proposal
fixtures.scenario: Recover an externally committed generation with a missing manifest, then fail latest-policy indexing on invalid UTF-8 and supersede it with a no-op proposal before retry.
oracles: Missing-manifest and indexing failures retain the old live collection and pinned query generation.
A newer no-op proposal still requires complete reconciliation.
Idle retry removes staged data, restores the latest configured inventory and uses IDs at or above the external reservation.

fixtures.name: collection_reload_recovery_checks_workspace_before_exposing_foreign_sources
fixtures.scenario: Attempt recovery after another writer adds foreign source provenance to a workspace-bound server.
oracles: Recovery remains pending and accepted settings stay unchanged.
The foreign source does not enter the live store state or live query results.
